topic_title: Law and Purpose of Vehicle Lighting Equipment
prompt: At what distance must you dim your high-beam headlights when approaching an oncoming vehicle in Texas?

options.text: Within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle approaching from opposite direction
Within 200 feet of an oncoming vehicle approaching from opposite direction
Within 1,000 feet of an oncoming vehicle approaching from opposite direction
Within 100 feet of an oncoming vehicle approaching from opposite direction
